items.prompt: Why can individually seq-cst atomic load and later decrement oversell one available unit?

options.text: An atomic operation is always a data race
options.why: Proper atomic operations avoid that data-race issue.

options.text: Sequential consistency forces every algorithm to be correct
options.why: It does not make several operations indivisible as a group.

options.text: The compiler must ignore every load
options.why: The logical stale-decision trace needs no ignored load.

options.text: Check and act remain separate operations
options.why: Check and act are not automatically one atomic transaction.

items.explanation: Logical resource invariants can fail even without a data race.
